title: Normalize first 10 legacy closed 1104 task records and retire schema debt
goal: Reconcile git-verified historical provenance (base_commit, implementation_commit, verified_commit, closed) and surviving Core scopes across the first 10 legacy .agents/tasks/done/T-*1104-1.json records (T-A2AEXEC1104-1 through T-CONFIGBACKUPENV1104-1) and remove their 10 entries from tests/task_record_schema_debt.json (81 -> 71).
notes: Phase 1 normalizes T-A2AEXEC1104-1, T-ABICELL1104-1, T-ABIEVIMEMLLM4T1104-1, T-ABINATIVE1104-1, T-ABINATIVETANTIVY1104-1, T-AGENTSREDACT4T1104-1, T-CANDLECLOUD4T1104-1, T-CFGJSONTYPES1104-1, T-CLUSTERKEY1104-1, and T-CONFIGBACKUPENV1104-1 in .agents/tasks/done/ and shrinks tests/task_record_schema_debt.json from 81 to 71 entries without touching T-STEP1* or active claims.

reuse.searched: tests/task_records.rs, tests/task_record_schema_debt.json, and .agents/tasks/done/T-*1104-1.json in Susi Core and susi-dev-workflow in Susi Commercial Apps
reuse.why: Normalized the 10 legacy closed task records directly to the existing susi.task_record/v1 schema enforced by tests/task_records.rs (using susi_paths::hex::encode) without altering test harness code.
